# Third-party attribution - Universal LPC art

All character sprite art used by this project comes from the
**Universal LPC Spritesheet Character Generator** by LiberatedPixelCup,
pinned to commit `553ba7562534cbf32e7d9a502660f569d6b26512`.

- Repository: <https://github.com/liberatedpixelcup/Universal-LPC-Spritesheet-Character-Generator>
- Hot-linked art base (pinned): `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/liberatedpixelcup/Universal-LPC-Spritesheet-Character-Generator@553ba7562534cbf32e7d9a502660f569d6b26512/`
- Sheet definitions/palettes the catalog was generated from: `sheet_definitions/`, `palette_definitions/`
